name: rtgs_langgraph_workflow
description: LangGraph-style multi-agent workflow (declarative). Demonstrates agents and handoffs.

agents.purpose: select dataset files, infer scope and quick preview
merge monthly files into a single raw CSV; produce schema profile
infer schema, canonicalize columns, clean and transform rows
run data quality checks and flag issues; HITL approval for downstream steps
create embeddings & RAG index (semantic lookup) from cleaned data
run semantic Q&A on evidence and produce human-readable policy notes
